title: Broadcom: Recent Earnings Confirm Why It's The AI Stock I Trust The Least (NASDAQ:AVGO) - Seeking Alpha
snippet: # Broadcom: Recent Earnings Confirm Why It's The AI Stock I Trust The Least. * VMware remains Broadcom’s most attractive asset, yet its contribution is shrinking as lower-margin AI hardware dominates the revenue mix. I have been neutral on Broadcom (AVGO), while I have been bullish on other AI beneficiary stocks like Google (GOOGL)(GOOG), Nvidia (NVDA) and Micron (MU). **Analyst’s Disclosure:** I/we have no stock, option or similar derivative position in any of the companies mentioned, and no plans to initiate any such positions within the next 72 hours.
